chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shummun from Abdillah ibn Abd al-Rahman from Mis'ma ibn Abd al-Malik from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The saddle of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) was made of silver.
ai.seo_question: What material was the Prophet's camel saddle made of according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Tahdhib al-Ahkam highlights the material simplicity and nobility of the Prophet's possessions, specifically noting that the saddle (burah) of his camel was made of silver. In Shia scholarly tradition, this detail underscores the concept of *zuhd* (asceticism) not as poverty, but as dignified moderation, contrasting with the ostentatious displays often criticized in later eras. It serves as a practical model for the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers to maintain humility while possessing quality items.
